quality_share_provenance.caveat: MEASURED FROM RUNALYZE SPLITS, NOT FROM AUTHORED MANIFESTS -- weaker evidence than a graded week and it must not be mistaken for manifest-grade data. None of these four weeks has a manifest, so each session's rep count was read off its splits rather than from a prescription, and the sessions were identified by rep structure rather than by what the plan asked for. Backfilled 2026-08-05 so quality-share-drift is live on its first graded week; recompute from manifests as they are authored.
quality_share_provenance.definition: First rep to last rep of each quality session, plus a race's whole duration, over the week's total moving seconds. Computed by the same grade_week.core_seconds() that grades a live week, so the baseline and the weeks measured against it are the same measurement.
quality_share_provenance.detector_note: Six of the seven candidate sessions segmented with the detected rep count matching the count read off the splits. The exception is 07-02's 6x100m, where the floats are LONGER than the reps and median-distance classification marks the wrong segments -- it reported 11 reps against 6. Excluded on other grounds anyway, but worth recording as a real limit of unassisted detection.

sessions.2026-06-29: 07-02 4x200m (366s) + 4x500m (573s). The same day's 6x100m in 16-18s is EXCLUDED: reps of a few seconds are `neuromuscular`, which sits in REPORTED_ROLES and not QUALITY_ROLES, so quality_seconds() would not count it either.
sessions.2026-07-06: 07-07 400/600/400/200/400 off standing rests (1167s) + 07-10 11x400m w/ 120m float (1516s). BOTH were absent from `quality_sessions` below, which was assembled for pace-creep and is not an exhaustive list -- 07-10 averages 151 bpm, under the 162 sub-T ceiling, and would have been missed by a heart-rate filter alone. Its rep structure is unmistakable.
sessions.2026-07-20: 07-26's four descending miles inside a 10.7-mile run -- 7:15, 6:57, 6:45, 6:31 with easy miles either side (1649s). ATHLETE-CONFIRMED 2026-08-05 as prescribed work rather than a long run pushed in the middle; without it the week reads 0% and the mean drops to 6.9%.

resting_hr_note: Falling, not rising: 47.0 -> 43.0 bpm across the block (-4.0). rubric.md calls a sustained rise the signal that outweighs everything else in the document; this is the opposite and is the strongest available reassurance against the flags below.

2026-07-20.note: Graded 2026-08-05. Workout execution is not scored: the week's only quality work is the Sunday progression, and hr.progression_tiers is null.
